verdict.rationale: Linear's developer docs are served as raw Markdown pages (e.g. graphql.md, webhooks.md, sdk.md, rate-limiting.md), which an agent could plausibly ingest directly. There is also agent-focused guidance in agents.md and the agent interaction guidelines (aig.md). However, nothing in the pack shows an llms.txt index or docs explicitly designed for agents to consume; the agent docs are written for developers building agents. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, explicit documentation that the Markdown docs are meant for LLM/agent consumption, and independent or hands-on confirmation that agents can use them effectively.
